firstPlayerRule: The rulebook just says to pick a starting player, without naming a method. In each later round, the player who lost the previous round starts.
clarifications: Jaipur is a two-player game; players alternate turns.
A new round is set up again whenever neither player yet has 2 Seals of Excellence.
